articles.title: Rank shares slip 3% as UK machine games duty rise to cost £9 mln a year
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Shares in Rank Group PLC (LON:RNK) were down 3% on Thursday after the owner of Grosvenor Casinos and Mecca Bingo said a rise in UK machine games duty announced in the budget would cost it around £9 million a year.
